item.text:
Added view transitions to the product gallery. Clicking a card morphs its color-block thumbnail into the matching detail hero, while navigation slides forward into the detail page and backward to the grid. The detail skeleton fades out as its content fades in.

The transition logic is in [NavigationTransitions.tsx](/workspace/app/NavigationTransitions.tsx), with animation and reduced-motion rules in [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css). When a browser lacks the View Transition API, links use normal navigation.

The production build, TypeScript check, and diff check passed. I could not visually test the animation because this workspace has no browser installed.
